usage: 動物 (animal) is a noun used to refer to living creatures that are not humans or plants.
You can use 動物 in both singular and plural contexts without changing the form.
動物 often appears in general discussions about wildlife, pets, or biology.
It can be paired with other words to specify types of animals, like 野生動物 (wild animals).
動物 can be used as a subject or object in a sentence.
